title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
What the live paper record shows is the engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. Every position here is paper, and one trade says nothing about a strategy. The record is a running log of paper signals and outcomes, not a proof of future results.

## Paper only, and one trade means nothing

Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. Live starts are counted from 1 October 2026 for trend-daily-v005 and from 9 October 2026 for trend-daily-v006. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, about two trades in three lost and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. With that framing, the live record should be read as a small paper sample that can move in either direction and does not establish anything about future performance.

## Open positions and the most recent closed trade

htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 shows 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 shows 0 positions open on paper. The record also names a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 that has been open since, so one open paper position is named even though the three engines listed in the snapshot show 0 positions open on paper. The most recent closed trade named is ATOM, entered at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close and exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703, for -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The open and closed entries are reported exactly as the running record shows them, without adjustment or interpretation beyond the stated numbers.

## What the market filter is allowing

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. Both of those trend engines show 0 positions open on paper. htf-rsi-v007 also shows 0 positions open on paper. The record therefore shows a market filter that is off in both trend engines at the same time as 0 open positions in those engines. The snapshot states the filter state and the position count; it does not state a cause, a trigger, or a future change. No projection is made from the filter being off.

## Closed-trade averages and distances to breakout

htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with an average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with an average -13.34% net per trade. These are the closed-trade counts and averages in the record, and they are small samples from paper trading. For trend-daily-v005, the closest names to their 20-day breakout are AVAXUSDT at 8.56% below its high, TRXUSDT at 11.41% below its high, and XLMUSDT at 15.20% below its high. For trend-daily-v006, the closest names are JUPUSDT at 8.39% below its high, AVAXUSDT at 8.56% below its high, and TRXUSDT at 11.41% below its high. These percentages describe how far those names are from their 20-day highs in the record. They are measurements, not entry signals, and they do not predict whether any trade will occur.

## Where the same numbers appear

The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-14T15:07:03.067Z. The record updates continuously, so the counts, percentages, and positions here are a snapshot of the running record rather than a final statement. Because every position is paper and the samples are small, the record should be read as a running log of signals and outcomes, with no advice, no predictions, and no price targets.
